title: Divergence: thermite-skill render_type_arm Type::Unit arm teaches an unparseable example (no req)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Failing test at thermite-skill/tests/divergence_unit_arm_example.rs::rendered_fn_examples_parse_clean (run with --ignored) demonstrates the divergence. render_type_arm's Type::Unit arm in generate.rs renders the example `fn log() -> () ens true fx pure { }` which OMITS the mandatory req clause; thermite_syntax::parser::parse rejects it with 'clause `req` is out of order'. The same fn WITH `req true` parses clean. The skill's own render_grammar prose states 'absence of any is a parse error'. Authority: thermite-design.md §10 (skill IS the spec, no version skew); skill-generator.md REQ-10/REQ-8. R-CHAR-3: expected value = parser-accepts, not copied from generate.rs.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Minimal single-file fix: correct render_type_arm's Type::Unit arm example in thermite-skill/src/generate.rs from `fn log() -> () ens true fx pure { }` to `fn log() -> () req true ens true fx pure { }` (add the mandatory req clause; clauses now in req->ens->fx order per thermite-design.md §4.1). Root cause is the invalid example STRING, not the REQ-8 compile-force mechanism (untouched). Re-checked every other render_*_arm example: all other fn/spec-fn examples are intentional ..-placeholder fragments or bare signatures (not standalone programs); only the Type::Unit arm was a complete program and the only invalid one. Un-ignore the pinned test rendered_fn_examples_parse_clean and broaden it to sweep EVERY complete rendered fn/spec-fn example and assert each parses clean (permanent regression guard). Regenerate THERMITE.skill.md. Authority: thermite-design.md §10/§4.1, skill-generator.md REQ-8/REQ-10.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: FIXED in commit 04412aa (single file thermite-skill/src/generate.rs + regenerated THERMITE.skill.md). Type::Unit arm example corrected: `fn log() -> () ens true fx pure { }` -> `fn log() -> () req true ens true fx pure { }` (mandatory req added, req->ens->fx order). Only complete-program example among the arms; all others are ..-fragments/signatures. Pinned test rendered_fn_examples_parse_clean un-ignored + broadened to parse EVERY complete rendered fn/spec-fn example clean — now passes (1 test). Skill regenerated; committed_skill_is_fresh passes.
